facts.value: MyPath2ASU® is your suite of customized self-service transfer tools.
Plan to meet with an academic advisor to ensure your courses will meet degree requirements.
There is no need to sign up again unless it has been more than four years since you signed up, or if you are changing your major or moving to a newer catalog year.

Students who signed up for a MAPP and want to change to a different major will need to sign up for the new major through https://redirect.maricopa.edu/student-center. Consult your community college academic advisor first to understand potential consequences of making a program plan change.
Live-hosted sessions with ASU enrollment and academic team members and current students who can answer your questions.
